answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity’s collateral in an escrow and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise penalties scale as O(k²), so splitting control among aliases increases the slash rather than diluting it. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation compounds the loss, producing an exponential multiplier on the swarm’s capital. A summit beacon may expose correlated timing, while ferrous records preserve auditable evidence.
